text.en: This Order may be cited as the Penal Code (Amendment) Order, 2021. of new section 380B into Chapter 22

heading.en: Insertion of new section 380B into Chapter 22

text.en: The Code is amended by repealing section 411 and by substituting the new section therefor - stolen property
The Code is amended by repealing section 414 and by substituting the new section therefor - concealment of stolen property

The Code is amended by inserting the following new section immediately 427 A - causing disruption to key service 427B. Ill Whoever commits mischief by doing any act which causes, or is likely to cause, a disruption to the provision of any key service shall be punished with imprisonment for a term of not less than 3 and not more than 10 years and whipping with not less than 4 strokes than 12 strokes. 121 In any case in which section 258 of the Criminal Procedure 71 applies, the Court shall sentence the offender, instead of whipping, to imprisonment for a term which may extend to 12 months, in punishment to which he has been sentenced under this 131 For the purposes of subsection Ill. "key service" means any of the following services - (a} a service directly related to the provision to the general of water, sewerage, drainage, gas, electricity, waste collection and disposal, newspapers, broadcasting, telecommunications and forms of mass media communication !including radio and television services!; (b} and rescue service, a fire·fighting service, a service providing rapid response to requests for help in a medical or other health emergency service; (c} a service directly related to the provision to the general of health or healthcare services at a hospital, healthcare or other like institution; (d} a service that is critical to ensuring the reliable supply in Brunei Darussalam of food which is safe and suitable for human fe} a service directly related to ensuring the provision to the general public of reliable and safe public transport by land, water or air within Brunei Darussalam or to and from Brunei Darussalam; If! a payments clearing and settlement service for payment or securities, a service directly related to the provision to the general public of banking facilities and financial services with banking business, a securities trading, clearing and settlement service, and any other like service that is necessary to the market or financial institutions in Brunei Darussalam or the disruption of which would have a widespread adverse effect on the financial system in Brunei Darussalam or the economy of Brunei Darussalam, or both; (g} any other service that is critical to maintaining public health, the social and economic stability of Brunei Darussalam or its people, or its national security. An act of mischief which damages an electricity licensee's power generation facility that is used to supply electricity to a public an act which is likely to cause disruption to a key service even though there is no actual disruption to that power supply.". amendment of First Schedule to Chapter 7

heading.en: Consequential amendment of First Schedule to Chapter 7

(1) Whoever receives or retains any property, knowing or having reason to believe the property to be stolen property or property obtained in or in part tl1rough an offence involving fraud or dishonesty, shall be with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years, fine or both.

(2) If the stolen property is related to a provision of any key service or any component part of a provision of any key service as defined in section 380B, a person convicted of an offence under this section shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 10 years, fine or both.

(3) It is a defence for a person charged with an offence under this to prove that he has a reasonable excuse to receive or retain ilie and that he exercised reasonable care as soon as practicable after having the knowledge or reason to believe the property to be stolen property or property obtained in whole or in part through an offence involving fraud or dishonesty.". of section 414

111 Whoever voluntarily assists in concealing or disposing of or away with property which he knows or has reason to believe to be stolen property or property obtained in whole or in part through any criminal offence involving fraud or dishonesty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years and fine. 121 If the property mentioned in subsection Ill is related to a provision of any key service or any component part of a provision of any key service as defined in section 380B, a person convicted of an offence this section shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 10 years, fine or both.". of new section 427B
